reason: A DSH browser plugin that opens git diffs in a standalone, side-by-side review interface with syntax highlighting, navigation, and inline comments that can be submitted through the chat composer.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面中将 Git diff 打开为独立的双列代码审查页面，并提供语法高亮、文件导航和行内评论功能。
summaries.en: Opens Git diffs from the DSH web interface in a standalone side-by-side review page with syntax highlighting, file navigation, and inline comments.

capabilities: Reads git diff content displayed in the DSH web interface
Adds code-review controls and a standalone diff view in a new browser tab
Parses and syntax-highlights diff content locally in the browser
Collects inline comments and writes formatted review text into the DSH composer
